releaseNotes:
SecApper Live Update v1.1.2:
• Standalone Double-Click Unlock Modal: Double-clicking any locked folder in Windows Explorer immediately presents the centered Unlock popup dialog without opening the main application window.
• DirectUI & Windows 11 Explorer Interception: Deep descendant UI Automation inspects Explorer dialogs and cleanly dismisses permission prompts via IDCANCEL.
• Concurrency & Lock-Free Downloader: Uses isolated staging and verifies existing packages to eliminate 'used by another process' file access conflicts.
• Preserved Taskbar & Shell Integrity: Fixed installer Restart Manager settings to never interrupt explorer.exe, taskbar, or system tray.
• Automatic Re-Lock: Once unlocked and viewed in Windows Explorer, closing that folder window automatically re-locks the folder.
• Fully Dynamic User Setup: Replaced static profile defaults with per-user database storage in %LocalAppData%.
